_doc: Dynamic world (WorldEventManager). Situations last a few days and bend the city: archetypes / events / factions are weight multipliers, mods feed ModifierManager, effects are StoryManager effects applied on start. cond: min_day, min_heat, max_heat, bm (black market unlocked), person (someone you know). special: recall (people with chrome from a maker come back), casualties (n emergency patients queue up), trouble (someone you know needs help, via COMMS), district_shift (a faction takes the district). {district}, {faction}, {maker}, {name} are filled in. News reacts to what you do (reactive) with cooldowns; filler keeps the wire alive.

situations.headline: Gang war spills across {district}: three dead on Canal Street
situations.body: Rival crews are settling a debt with rifles. Hospitals won't send vans below the Low Line.

situations.headline: {maker} recalls implants after 'calibration anomalies'
situations.body: Owners are told to visit an authorised clinic. Nobody down here can afford an authorised clinic.

situations.headline: MedBoard opens inquiry into unlicensed clinics in {district}
situations.body: Inspectors with tablets and armed escorts. Anyone with a back room is nervous.

situations.headline: {faction} take over the {district} markets
situations.body: New faces collect protection. Old faces disappeared overnight.

situations.headline: Fixer known as '{name}' hasn't been seen in four days
situations.body: Their contacts are dark. Prices on unregistered chrome jump overnight.
situations.end: '{name}' turned up in the canal. Prices drift back down.

situations.headline: Port strike: sterile supplies short across the lower city
situations.body: Couriers are charging triple. Some clinics are boiling gauze again.
situations.end: Port strike broken. Supply vans are moving.

situations.headline: Low Line tram derails in {district}: dozens hurt
situations.body: Every clinic with a light on is taking the overflow.
situations.end: Low Line reopens. Nobody has been charged.

situations.headline: Lyra Biocomp launches 'neural wellness' program for employees
situations.body: Free coprocessors for staff. The fine print is twelve pages long.

situations.headline: Grid failure across the lower city
situations.body: Twelve hours without power. Generators are worth more than chrome tonight.

trouble.subject: {name} is in trouble
trouble.body: A kid you don't know runs in: "{name} sent me. Security picked them up in a sweep and they're bleeding in a holding cell. They said you'd help."

actions.label: BRING THEM IN. I'LL PATCH THEM UP
